parsed.rationale: All three initializers — `Announcement.init(id:hour:chronOrderID:timeCreated:)`, `Breakpoint.init(id:hour:chronOrderID:timeCreated:)`, and `Talkset.init(id:hour:chronOrderID:timeCreated:)` — share an identical parameter label signature `(id:hour:chronOrderID:timeCreated:)` across three distinct types in the same `Playlist` package. This is a textbook case of parallel construction over a shared domain concept (a playlist entry with an identity, an hour slot, a chronological order ID, and a creation timestamp). Introducing a protocol `PlaylistEntry` with these four requirements and providing a default memberwise initialiser via a protocol extension would eliminate the triplication. None of the participating records carry any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no restraint rule applies.
